{fb:0080}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}{name:0180} died in battle the other day.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}I expect that soul is wandering in Lord Remiel's keeping. Such a fine hero, too. It's a shame.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{e0:660A}{spk:0080}{n}Um, may I have a word, Angel?{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}I haven't had much time off lately, so I was hoping I might have a rest...{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Not right away, but I'd be grateful if you could give me a holiday sometime soon.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0680}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Angel, I'm back.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}I'm very sorry for taking time off without permission.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}From today I'll start afresh and work hard, so please count on me.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0380}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Angel, the soul of {name:0180} has left Lord Remiel's keeping.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Now {name:0180} will never return to Infos.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}For the sake of the late {name:0180}, let's scout a new hero and lead Infos to peace.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0780}{n}{e0:E0FF}{spk:0080}{n}Angel, the Stagnation of Time has grown severe, and the land of Infos is falling to ruin.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}If it keeps getting worse, Infos will collapse before ten years have even passed.{n}{wait}{clear}{e0:E0FF}Let's lead Infos to peace with the heroes, as soon as we can.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
